colors.statusBarSyncForeground.descripti: Status bar text color when both incoming and outgoing commits exist (sync needed)
colors.statusBarPullForeground.descripti: Status bar text color when incoming commits are available (pull needed)
colors.statusBarPushForeground.descripti: Status bar text color when there are unpushed commits or the branch is not on remote
colors.statusBarDirtyForeground.descript: Status bar text color when there are uncommitted changes
configuration.title: VersionDock
configuration.changesViewMode.descriptio: How to display changed files in the Changes tab.
configuration.changesViewMode.enum.simpl: Show Staged and Unstaged sections per repository (default behavior)
configuration.changesViewMode.enum.chang: Show files grouped by Changelists, similar to PhpStorm
configuration.changesViewMode.enum.vscod: Show Staged Changes / Changes sections like native VS Code, with inline stage/unstage buttons
configuration.layoutDensity.enum.comfort: Comfortable (default): Rounded card layout (8px radius with moderate padding), balancing modern aesthetics and space
configuration.layoutDensity.enum.compact: Compact: Flush straight-edge layout, no outer padding, maximum space utilization
configuration.defaultCommitAction.descri: Default action for the commit button in the Commit Panel.
configuration.defaultCommitAction.enum.c: The main button commits without pushing
The main button commits and pushes immediately
configuration.defaultSaveAction.descript: Default action for the Save button in the Commit Panel.
configuration.defaultSaveAction.enum.sta: The main Save button stashes selected changes
configuration.defaultSaveAction.enum.she: The main Save button shelves selected changes
configuration.promptAddUntrackedToGit.de: Show a prompt when new untracked files are detected, offering to add them to Git.
configuration.projectColors.description: Map of workspace folder/repository name to hex color for the commit graph (e.g. {"my-repo": "#ff6b6b"})
configuration.showProfileStatusBar.descr: Show the VersionDock account and Git identity status bar item in the bottom status bar.
configuration.git.autoFetchInterval.desc: Interval in minutes for automatically fetching remote changes in the background (git fetch, 0 = disabled, default: 15).
configuration.git.autoFetchOnFocus.descr: Automatically fetch remote changes (git fetch) in the background when VS Code window regains focus (with cooldown, enabled by default).
configuration.fetchOnStartup.description: Automatically fetch all remotes when the extension activates
configuration.autoRefreshInterval.descri: Interval in seconds for polling and refreshing local workspace status (default: 0 = disabled; only needed when file system watchers fail, e.g. on remote mounts or Docker).
configuration.notifyOnIncomingCommits.de: Show a notification on startup when there are incoming commits available to pull
configuration.notifyOnUnpushedCommits.de: Show a notification on startup when there are unpushed commits ready to push
configuration.suppressDivergedBranchWarn: Suppress the 'Repositories are not on the same branch' warning in the Git menu and status bar for multi-repository workspaces.
configuration.repositoryScanMaxDepth.des: Maximum depth of workspace subfolders to scan for Git repositories (0 = only workspace folders).
configuration.repositoryScanIgnoredFolde: Folder names or workspace-relative paths to skip while scanning for nested Git repositories.
configuration.graphMaxCommits.descriptio: Maximum commits to display in Git Log; lightweight Git ancestry may load beyond this limit to keep graph lanes stable
configuration.gitAnnotationsEnabled.desc: Enable Git/SVN annotations in the editor.
configuration.gitGhostTextEnabled.descri: Enable inline Git/SVN ghost text annotations in the editor.
configuration.git.noVerify.description: Bypass Git pre-commit and commit-msg hooks by running 'git commit --no-verify'.
configuration.git.autoCommitResolvedMerg: Automatically commit the merge when all conflicts in a repository are resolved (enabled by default).
configuration.guard.warnOnLargeFiles.des: Warn before committing files larger than the specified size limit.
configuration.guard.largeFileSizeLimitMB: Size threshold in megabytes for large file commit warning (default: 50MB).
configuration.guard.warnOnDetachedHead.d: Warn before committing in detached HEAD or during an ongoing rebase, offering to create a branch.
configuration.guard.warnOnCrlf.descripti: Warn if CRLF line separators are about to be committed in text files.
configuration.guard.warnOnInvalidFileNam: Warn when committing files with names that may cause issues on Windows or other operating systems (e.g. invalid characters or case collisions).
configuration.git.protectedBranches.desc: List of protected branch name patterns (e.g. master, main, release/*) that trigger warnings on push and force push.
configuration.git.syncProtectedBranchesF: Automatically sync branch protection rules from GitHub, GitLab, and Gitee for remote repositories.
configuration.git.showPushDialogForProte: Show confirmation dialog before pushing to protected branches.
configuration.git.onPushRejected.descrip: Behavior when a push is rejected because the remote is ahead (non-fast-forward).
configuration.git.onPushRejected.enum.pr: Prompt to Rebase & Push, Force Push, or Cancel (JetBrains-style).
configuration.git.onPushRejected.enum.re: Automatically pull and rebase before retrying push.
configuration.git.onPushRejected.enum.er: Show the error notification without interactive recovery.
configuration.git.branchCleanCharacter.d: Character to replace invalid characters and whitespace in Git branch names (e.g. '-').
configuration.git.cherryPickAddSuffix.de: Add 'cherry-picked from <hash>' suffix when cherry-picking commits (git cherry-pick -x).
configuration.git.useSafeForcePush.descr: Use '--force-with-lease' (safe force push) when force pushing from the extension, or '--force' when disabled.
configuration.git.catFileFilterMode.desc: Filter transformation mode applied when reading file content from Git revisions or stages.
configuration.git.catFileFilterMode.enum: Use '--filters' flag (recommended, supports Git LFS and smudge/clean filters).
Use '--textconv' flag (applies format-specific text conversion filters).
Read raw object content directly from repository without applying any transformations.
configuration.git.fetchTags.description: Policy for fetching tags when fetching branches from remote repositories.
configuration.git.fetchTags.enum.auto: Follow default Git local and remote configuration.
configuration.git.fetchTags.enum.all: Force fetching all remote tags (using '--tags' flag).
configuration.git.fetchTags.enum.none: Never fetch remote tags (using '--no-tags' flag to avoid local tag pollution).
configuration.git.excludeIgnoredDirector: Automatically exclude directories ignored by .gitignore when scanning and analyzing repositories.
configuration.updateProject.method.descr: Strategy used when updating projects from remote (Merge or Rebase).
Rebase local commits on top of incoming remote changes (recommended for clean history).
Merge incoming remote changes into the current branch.
Ask for strategy every time Update Project is executed.
configuration.updateProject.cleanWorking: How to clean and automatically restore uncommitted local changes during project update.
Automatically shelve uncommitted changes before updating and unshelve them afterward (preserves changelists).
Automatically stash uncommitted changes before updating and pop stash afterward.
configuration.updateProject.showUpdateNo: Show a notification with update details when new commits are received after project update.
configuration.git.cloneRecursiveSubmodul: Recursively clone submodules when cloning a repository ('git clone --recurse-submodules').
Comparison base when viewing differences for shelved or stashed changes.
Compare with the current local working tree version of the file.
Compare with the base / parent commit version when the stash or shelf was created.
configuration.ai.provider.description: Default provider used by VersionDock AI features in Provider mode. Ignored in Agent CLI mode.
configuration.ai.provider.enum.githubCop: Use GitHub Copilot through the VS Code Language Model API.
configuration.ai.provider.enum.openai: Use an OpenAI API endpoint with the selected API protocol.
configuration.ai.provider.enum.claude: Use the Anthropic Claude Messages API.
configuration.ai.provider.enum.custom: Use a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint with the selected API protocol.
configuration.ai.apiProtocol.description: HTTP API protocol for OpenAI and custom providers. GitHub Copilot, Claude, Gemini, and Agent CLI mode ignore this setting.
configuration.ai.model.description: Model name for provider-based VersionDock AI features. For GitHub Copilot, leave empty to select a model automatically. Ignored in Agent CLI mode.
configuration.ai.apiUrl.description: API base URL or full endpoint. A host address automatically uses the selected protocol path; OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini use their official endpoint when left empty. Custom providers still require this setting. Ignored for GitHub Copilot and Agent CLI mode.
configuration.ai.apiKey.description: API key for VersionDock AI features using OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or custom providers. Ignored for GitHub Copilot and Agent CLI mode.
configuration.ai.maxInputTokens.descript: Maximum estimated prepared-context size for VersionDock AI features. Copilot uses the selected model limit; Agent CLI mode uses this as a local safety budget.
configuration.ai.maxOutputTokens.descrip: Maximum output-token ceiling for provider requests and local output-budget calculations. Copilot controls its own output budget.
commands.aiCli.check.title: VersionDock: Check Current AI CLI
configuration.ai.executionMode.descripti: Choose between the existing model provider integration and a local agent CLI running on the extension host.
configuration.ai.executionMode.enum.prov: Use GitHub Copilot or the configured HTTP API provider.
configuration.ai.executionMode.enum.agen: Run a local Claude, Codex, Antigravity, or OpenCode agent CLI. The external CLI inspects files within granted working roots under read-only sandboxes or terminal containment restrictions.
configuration.ai.cli.provider.descriptio: Agent CLI used when AI execution mode is Agent CLI.
configuration.ai.cli.provider.enum.claud: Use Claude Code in non-interactive, non-persistent plan mode.
configuration.ai.cli.provider.enum.codex: Use Codex CLI in non-interactive, ephemeral, read-only mode.
configuration.ai.cli.provider.enum.antig: Use Antigravity CLI in non-interactive plan mode and reuse one VersionDock conversation per working root.
configuration.ai.cli.provider.enum.openc: Use OpenCode in read-only mode and delete the VersionDock session after each request.
configuration.ai.cli.model.description: Optional CLI model override. Leave empty to use the selected CLI's own default model. For OpenCode, an unqualified model ID is treated as opencode/<id>; use provider/model for another provider.
configuration.ai.cli.timeoutSeconds.desc: Maximum time allowed for one agent CLI request, in seconds.
configuration.ai.cli.claudePath.descript: Claude executable name or absolute path on the extension host.
configuration.ai.cli.codexPath.descripti: Codex executable name or absolute path on the extension host.
configuration.ai.cli.antigravityPath.des: Antigravity CLI executable name or absolute path on the extension host.
configuration.ai.cli.opencodePath.descri: OpenCode executable name or absolute path on the extension host.
